lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills, arranged in a semi-regular grid with inter-blob spacing increasing slightly towards the posterior tail region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a distinct grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extends across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 18 discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher spatial concentration observed along the anterior margin and a sparser distribution near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; minor fraying is observed on the distal posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a unique pattern of high-luminance spots that decrease in diameter and increase in spatial density toward the posterior tips of both the upper and lower lobes.
